title: OPC UA Read
text: Read data from OPC UA server, 3 outputs; {Server} defines OPC UA server for block drop-down, {Nodes} sets the list of OPC UA server, {Show quality port} adds quality output to block, {Show timestamp port} adds timestamp output to block, {Show timestamp port as} sets the timestamp basis Seconds and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Value
ports.summary: Current data values of selected nodes scalar | bus

ports.name: Timestamp
ports.summary: Timestamp of selected nodes data seconds (default) | date number

ports.name: Quality
ports.summary: Quality of read data from selected nodes boolean

params.name: Server
params.values: Define OPC UA server for block drop-down list

params.name: Nodes
params.values: List of OPC UA server nodes table

params.name: Show quality port
params.values: Add quality output to block on (default) | off

params.name: Show timestamp port
params.values: Add timestamp output to block on (default) | off

params.name: Show timestamp port as
params.values: Set timestamp basis Seconds since start (default) | Serial date number

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time for read operation -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar
